# bdsea -- one row per fleet per day of fighting (SEA).
#
# Replaces balance_bdsea_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 6,001 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="bdsea_d"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (13), each a map of its own:
#     d        <- global_var:bdday
#     loc      <- scope:bd_uloc
#     c        <- scope:bd_owner
#     p        <- global_var:bstr
#     q        <- global_var:bdrop
#     n0       <- global_var:bdc6
#     n1       <- global_var:bdc7
#     n2       <- global_var:bdc8
#     n3       <- global_var:bdc9
#     m0       <- local_var:bcd6
#     m1       <- local_var:bcd7
#     m2       <- local_var:bcd8
#     m3       <- local_var:bcd9
#
# global_var:bdsea_count is still the row count and still the last key written.

# WHY THESE READ local_var AND NOT global_var
#   bdday, bstr, bdrop and bdc0..bdc9 were globals when this file was written.
#   The slowdown fix converted 63 global operations in balance_bd_unit_step to
#   locals -- a global write costs ~124 us against a local's 0.2 -- and these
#   reads were not moved with them. Reading an unset global writes nothing and
#   raises nothing, so from that day the daily log recorded only the country,
#   the location and the standing counts: no date, no strength, no per-day
#   losses. Measured in the 1482 save -- rows 1..3210 carry dates and losses and
#   predate the change, rows 3211..6850 carry standing and nothing else.
bdsea_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bdsea_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bdsea_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bdsea_count add = 1 }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_d key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdday }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_loc key = global_var:bdsea_count value = scope:bd_uloc }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_c key = global_var:bdsea_count value = scope:bd_owner }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_p key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bstr }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_q key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdrop }
	# which unit, which fight, what kind of row -- see balance_bd_row_ids
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_u key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdu }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_b key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdb }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_k key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdk }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_n0 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdc6 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_n1 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdc7 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_n2 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdc8 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_n3 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bdc9 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_m0 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bcd6 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_m1 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bcd7 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_m2 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bcd8 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bdsea_m3 key = global_var:bdsea_count value = local_var:bcd9 }
}
